sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 20336 of 2024

Petitioner :- Dharmendra And 4 Others
Respondent :- State Of Up And 3 Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Ved Prakash Ojha
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arvind Singh Sangwan,J.
Hon'ble Mohd. Azhar Husain Idrisi,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned AGA for the State.

2. The instant writ petition has been filed with a prayer to quash the First Information Report dated 9.10.2024 registered as Case Crime No.0339 of 2024, under Sections 323, 504, 506, 498A of IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Mahrauni, District lalitpur.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that he does not press the present petition qua petitioner no.1, Dharmendra, husband of the informant.
Therefore, petition qua petitioner no.1 is dismissed as withdrawn.

4. Counsel further submits that primary allegations of causing injuries are against the husband and there are general allegations against the petitioner no.2 to 5 who are family members of the of the informant.

sentences.text:
Be that as it may, this petition is disposed of with a direction that till submission of police report,
no coercive action shall be taken against the petitioner nos. 2 to 5 under Section 193 of BNSS, 2023.
It is also provided that the petitioner no.2 to 5 shall fully cooperate in the investigation, failing which they shall not be entitled to the benefit of this order.
However, it will be open to the Investigating Officer to proceed against petitioner no.1 in accordance with law.
